item.title: Whiskers 0.8.40
item.description:
What's New in 0.8.40

### AI Enhancement Prompts

  • Added a richer set of built-in prompt styles so you can quickly turn dictation into polished writing, casual messages, summaries, emails, translations, and first drafts
  • Improved prompt handling so AI enhancement stays focused on your spoken words instead of getting distracted by text visible on screen

    • ### Bulk Transcription

  • Fixed the Manage Prompts shortcut in Bulk Transcription so it opens the right AI settings section again
  • Improved prompt navigation from bulk transcription so it lands directly on prompt controls instead of sending you through a separate sheet

    • ### General Settings

  • Improved update status in General settings so background refreshes keep the last known result visible instead of briefly falling back to a less useful state
